eligibility.quote: according to the following gdb debug, it seems that created subscription is not added to `rmw_wait` to be executed for Fast-DDS case. So subscription will never be executed by executer.

failed_conditions.quote: [Conclusion](https://github.com/ros2/rmw_fastrtps/issues/606#issuecomment-1125824269) was that if a node is assigned to multiple executors running asynchronously, it is unable to notify all of them about creating/destroying subscriptions etc..

resolution.quote: @SteveMacenski @gezp I confirmed that this problem has been addressed by https://github.com/ros2/rmw_fastrtps/pull/619. please feel free to reopen if you still have this issue in rolling.

notes: Verified rmw_fastrtps#613 issue body and full comment thread. Eligible at step 6: the guard condition is effectively an exclusive resource — rmw_fastrtps's implementation supports only one attached wait set, so the two executors' wait sets contend for it and the second never wakes; exclusive_resource_conflict with resource:node_notify_guard_condition, api:rmw_wait and api:rmw_trigger_guard_condition is a fair reading of the quoted conclusion. Loudness silent_documented/run agreed: no build/connect/activate diagnostic; the only symptom is missing callbacks at run time, root-caused via gdb. Resolution recommended agreed: PR #619 was merged and the maintainer confirmed the problem addressed, but the confirmation names no rclcpp/rmw_fastrtps revisions, so the resolved composition is not identified by revision.
